warRiskPremium.note: ESCALATION RESUMED — DIPLOMATIC TRACK COLLAPSED: Jul 31: US media report US and Israel may be imminently launching extensive attacks on Iran's civilian infrastructure including power plants and petrochemicals — operation could last up to two weeks and aim to cut electricity across Tehran; Trump has yet to give final authorisation (Al Jazeera, Aug 1). Israel Defense Minister Katz: 'we very much want to strike Iran's energy targets' — US not approving at present over concern Iran would strike neighbours and trigger global oil crisis. Iran's wartime military command (Gen Abdollahi): 'flames of war' warning; Tasnim: armed forces prepared retaliation plan against US/Israel vital infrastructure. CSIS: US Patriot inventories under 1,000, THAAD ~250 — interceptor depletion. Oil: Brent above $90/bbl (strongest month since March), WTI ~$83. War-risk premium shock (~1,000%+) sustained. Updated 2026-08-02
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 升级恢复——外交轨道崩溃：7月31日：美国媒体报道美以可能即将对伊朗民用基础设施（发电厂、石化厂）发动大规模打击——行动可能持续两周，旨在切断德黑兰电力；特朗普尚未最终授权（半岛电视台，8月1日）。以色列防长卡茨：'我们非常想打击伊朗能源目标'——美国因担心伊朗报复邻国、引发全球石油危机而暂未批准。伊朗战时军事指挥部（阿卜杜拉希将军）：'战争之火'警告；塔斯尼姆：武装部队已准备针对美以关键基础设施的报复计划。CSIS：美国爱国者拦截弹库存降至1000枚以下、THAAD约250枚——拦截弹枯竭。油价：布伦特突破$90/桶（3月以来最强月度），WTI约$83。战争险溢价冲击（约1000%+）持续。更新于 2026-08-02

straitThroughput.value: ~0-1 mb/d | CLOSED — MoU cancelled, US strikes continue
straitThroughput.value_zh: 约0-1百万桶/天 | 关闭——谅解备忘录取消，美军持续打击
straitThroughput.note: STRAIT RE-CLOSED — DIPLOMATIC PAUSE COLLAPSED: Aug 1: Iran announces Strait of Hormuz 'closed once again' (News On AIR/IRNA); Khatam al-Anbiya HQ says waterway remains closed to traffic not approved by IRGC; 4 ships turned back. Two tanker incidents off Oman in 24h (UKMTO): GasLog LNG carrier damaged exiting Hormuz, tanker engine room hit by unknown projectile. Iran warns continued US maritime blockade could shut Hormuz and other waterways (Anadolu, Aug 1). US attacked at least five Iranian provinces overnight into Thursday (IRGC command centres, missile/drone facilities, coastal surveillance, air-defence, maritime). Iran state media: 'smoke of mistakenly trusting the US' promises of safe passage. Trump threatens harder strikes; White House warns Tehran over Hormuz attacks and truce violations. Oil: Brent above $90, strongest month since March. Iraq-Syria pipeline alternative structural. Updated 2026-08-02
straitThroughput.note_zh: 海峡重新关闭——外交暂停崩溃：8月1日：伊朗宣布霍尔木兹海峡'再次关闭'（新闻AIR/IRNA）；哈塔姆安比亚总部称水道仍对未经IRGC批准的船只关闭；4艘船被劝返。24小时内阿曼附近两起油轮事件（UKMTO）：GasLog液化天然气船出海峡时受损，油轮机舱被不明射弹击中。伊朗警告美国持续海上封锁可能导致霍尔木兹及其他水道关闭（阿纳多卢，8月1日）。美国周四凌晨前至少打击伊朗五个省份（IRGC指挥中心、导弹/无人机设施、海岸监视、防空、海上能力）。伊朗官方媒体：'误信美国'安全通行承诺的'烟雾'。特朗普威胁更严厉打击；白宫警告德黑兰在霍尔木兹的攻击和停火违规。油价：布伦特突破$90，3月以来最强月度。伊拉克-叙利亚管道替代方案结构性。更新于 2026-08-02

irgcStatementFreq.value_zh: 20-30次/周（危机水平，谅解备忘录取消）
irgcStatementFreq.note: IRGC statement frequency sustained at crisis level. NEW: Iran's wartime military command warns US 'moving at accelerating pace to fan flames of full-scale regional war' — countries serving as US defensive shield 'will burn in flames of war' (Al Jazeera, Aug 1). Tasnim: armed forces prepared extensive retaliation plan against US/Israel 'vital infrastructure'. Iran targets US base in Kuwait — Kuwait air defences destroy multiple Iranian drones, some damage to government facilities (Aug 1). IRGC/army strikes extend to energy infrastructure in Israel, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman. Iran warns continued US maritime blockade could shut Hormuz and other waterways. Iran: 'we have been victorious. But the victories of this war must be solidified' (Ghalibaf). Updated 2026-08-02
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: IRGC声明频率维持在危机水平。新：伊朗战时军事指挥部警告美国'正加速煽动全面地区战争之火'——充当美国防御盾牌的国家'将葬身战火'（半岛电视台，8月1日）。塔斯尼姆：武装部队已准备针对美以'关键基础设施'的全面报复计划。伊朗打击科威特美军基地——科威特防空系统摧毁多架伊朗无人机，政府设施受损（8月1日）。IRGC/军队打击扩展至以色列、沙特、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特、巴林、阿曼的能源基础设施。伊朗警告美国持续海上封锁可能导致霍尔木兹及其他水道关闭。伊朗：'我们已经胜利。但必须巩固战争的胜利成果'（卡利巴夫）。更新于 2026-08-02

fleetPosition.value: Active combat operations — 2 US killed in Jordan, MoU cancelled
fleetPosition.value_zh: 实战行动——2名美军在约旦阵亡，谅解备忘录取消
fleetPosition.note: ESCALATION RESUMED — US STRIKES CONTINUE, ENERGY TARGETS NEXT?: Overnight into Thursday Jul 30: US military attacked at least five Iranian provinces — IRGC command centres, missile and drone facilities, coastal surveillance, air-defence, maritime capabilities; multiple civilian casualties including a 2-year-old killed on Qeshm (Al Jazeera, Aug 1). Aug 1: Kuwait's army destroys multiple Iranian drones; Iran targeted US base in Kuwait. US embassies urge citizens to 'consider departing' region (France 24, Aug 1). Trump threatens more strikes; White House warns Tehran over Hormuz attacks and truce violations (AP, Aug 1). US/Israel reportedly preparing major strikes on Iran's energy infrastructure; Trump has yet to give final authorisation (Anadolu/AJ, Aug 1). CSIS: Patriot inventories under 1,000, THAAD ~250. US blockade of Iranian ports continues. Netanyahu-Trump meeting pending. Updated 2026-08-02
fleetPosition.note_zh: 升级恢复——美军打击持续，能源目标或下一步？：7月30日周四凌晨前：美军至少打击伊朗五个省份——IRGC指挥中心、导弹/无人机设施、海岸监视、防空、海上能力；多名平民伤亡，包括格什姆岛一名2岁儿童遇难（半岛电视台，8月1日）。8月1日：科威特军队摧毁多架伊朗无人机；伊朗打击科威特美军基地。美国使馆敦促公民'考虑撤离'该地区（法国24，8月1日）。特朗普威胁更多打击；白宫警告德黑兰在霍尔木兹的攻击和停火违规（美联社，8月1日）。美以据报道准备对伊朗能源基础设施发动重大打击；特朗普尚未最终授权（阿纳多卢/半岛，8月1日）。CSIS：爱国者拦截弹库存低于1000枚、THAAD约250枚。美国对伊朗港口的封锁持续。内塔尼亚胡-特朗普会晤待定。更新于 2026-08-02

saudiUaeStance.value: Saudi military strikes Houthi Hodeidah — conflict spreads to Yemen front
saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 沙特打击胡塞武装荷台达——冲突扩展至也门战线
saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: GCC CONFLICT EXPANDS TO MULTIPLE FRONTS: Houthis fire at Saudi oil facilities — 'New front in US-Iran war escalates' (Al Jazeera, Aug 1). Houthis announce Saudi naval blockade (Reuters, Jul 21); ships turn around in Red Sea after Bab al-Mandeb threats (Forbes, Jul 22). Riyadh attempting to form international coalition to counter Red Sea disruptions. US and Saudi Arabia jointly attacked Iraqi bases aligned with Tehran, killing at least 20 fighters and multiple IRGC advisers (AJ, Aug 1). Saudi military strikes Houthi-held Hodeidah (CNBC, Jul 25). Iran struck energy infrastructure in Saudi, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman (AJ, Aug 1). Saudi now directly engaged on Yemen + Red Sea fronts while Hormuz closed. Oman talking with Tehran on Hormuz navigation mechanisms. Updated 2026-08-02
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: GCC冲突扩展至多条战线：胡塞武装袭击沙特石油设施——'美伊战争新战线升级'（半岛电视台，8月1日）。胡塞武装宣布对沙特海上封锁（路透社，7月21日）；曼德海峡威胁后红海船只掉头（福布斯，7月22日）。利雅得正试图组建国际联盟应对红海中断。美国和沙特联合打击与德黑兰结盟的伊拉克基地，至少20名武装分子和多名IRGC顾问被杀（半岛，8月1日）。沙特打击胡塞武装控制的荷台达（CNBC，7月25日）。伊朗打击沙特、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特、巴林、阿曼的能源基础设施（半岛，8月1日）。霍尔木兹关闭之际，沙特在也门+红海战线直接参战。阿曼与伊朗就霍尔木兹航行机制进行会谈。更新于 2026-08-02
